user.title: Connect your B-route adapter
user.description: Select the USB adapter and enter the Route-B authentication ID and password your electricity retailer sent you.

data_description.device: Prefer a /dev/serial/by-id/... path: it survives re-plugging.

reauth_confirm.title: Update your Route-B credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The meter rejected the stored credentials. Enter the authentication ID and password your electricity retailer sent you.

error.invalid_auth_id: The authentication ID must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_password: The password must be 12 letters and digits.
error.cannot_connect: The serial device could not be opened. Check that it is plugged in and passed through to Home Assistant.
error.no_meter: No smart meter answered the scan. Check the credentials and the distance to the meter.
error.timeout: The adapter stopped responding. Unplug it, plug it back in and try again.
error.unknown: Pairing failed for an unexpected reason. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This smart meter is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Credentials updated. The integration will reconnect.
